job.title: Java Backend Entwickler (m/w/d)
job.location: Marburg an der Lahn, HE, Germany
job.email_body:
Dear Mr Lange,

A distributor depends on Java backends that move product, order and stock data reliably between systems – that is what I have built for five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs and microservices
– Resolved SAP ERP / MDM / Profisee integration bottlenecks
– Led query refactoring that cut response latency
– Daily use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, coding and docs

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I am also an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User. My CV and cover letter are attached. Do you have time for a short call in the coming days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Java Backend Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs, SQL & E-Commerce Integrations
tailoring.summary: Java backend developer with 5+ years building and running backends for large e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful and SOAP web services, microservices and integrations with ERP, PIM and third-party systems. Proven in SQL query optimization and performance tuning, JUnit testing, code reviews and production troubleshooting. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles with Git, Jenkins and Docker and uses AI tools daily in development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: MUSIK MEYER supplies music retailers across Europe, and that business runs on reliable backend systems for products, orders and partners. I want to bring five years of Java backend and integration work from large e-commerce platforms into a company where my code directly supports daily trade. From Karlsruhe, with a valid work permit, I can start on 16 December 2026.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Mr Lange, your Java Backend Developer role fits well: 5+ years Java/Spring Boot backends, REST/SOAP integrations and SQL tuning for e-commerce (Rockwell Automation, Shell). Start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Java Backend Developer
en.hook: A distributor like MUSIK MEYER depends on backends that move product, order and stock data reliably between systems. That is what I have built in Java for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I develop Spring-based backends and integrations for large e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Java backend development
bullets.text: 5+ years of Java, Spring and Spring Boot: RESTful APIs, microservices, design patterns and data modeling for enterprise commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: Interfaces & integrations
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, working directly with international technical teams; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP services and integrated external services via CCv2.

bullets.label: Database performance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Quality
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit; perform code reviews, support production issues and give technical guidance to junior developers.

en.logistics: I work independently and closely with business teams. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can strengthen MUSIK MEYER.
